title: Fix admin authentication and ICP connection in Admin Dashboard

requirements.text: Fix the Admin Dashboard so that after a successful Internet Identity login, the admin-check query waits for the authenticated actor to be fully initialized before calling `isCallerAdmin` on the backend. The current race condition causes the check to run with an anonymous identity, resulting in a 'Zugriff verweigert' / no admin rights error even for valid admins.

quotes: Admin dont work, it seems, no connection to ICP: Zugriff verweigert Sie haben keine Administratorrechte für diesen Bereich.

acceptanceCriteria: After logging in with Internet Identity, the Admin Dashboard loads without showing 'Zugriff verweigert' for a principal that has admin rights.
The `isCallerAdmin` call in `useIsCallerAdmin` / `useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout` only fires after the authenticated actor (from `useActor`) is ready and reflects the logged-in identity.
If the actor is not yet initialized, the admin check is deferred (not run with anonymous identity).
The admin dashboard correctly shows the management UI once the admin check resolves to true.

requirements.text: Ensure the backend actor used in all admin operations (collections, NFTs, etc.) is always created with the authenticated Internet Identity principal, not an anonymous identity. Verify that `useActor` re-initializes the actor when the identity changes from anonymous to authenticated.
acceptanceCriteria: After login, the actor returned by `useActor` uses the authenticated identity.
Admin mutations (create/edit/delete collections and NFTs) do not receive authorization errors after a valid admin logs in.
Logging out resets the actor to an anonymous identity and clears relevant React Query caches.

requirements.text: Display a clear loading state in the Admin Dashboard while the ICP actor is initializing or the admin check is pending. If the admin check definitively fails (user is not an admin), show a clear 'Access Denied' message in English. Do not show the access-denied message prematurely during the initialization phase.
acceptanceCriteria: A loading spinner or skeleton is shown while the actor is initializing or the admin check is in-flight.
The 'Access Denied' message only appears after the check has completed and confirmed the user is not an admin.
No flash of 'Access Denied' occurs for valid admins during the actor initialization delay.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
All fixes must be implemented in the frontend layer without changing the backend Motoko actor's isCallerAdmin logic.
nonGoals: Changing backend role-based access control logic.
Adding new admin features or changing the admin dashboard layout.
Modifying the Internet Identity authentication flow itself.
